notes.title: Smoke Bomb
notes.content:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

To make the game less punishing and frustrating, without making it easy, I decided on a change in the rule for triggering smoke bombs.
It will still respect the legend: [i]"To own the scrolls is to own the shadow and to cheat death."[/i]

So if you are hit and the number of scrolls in your possession is greater than or equal to the cost of a smoke bomb.
Then you will definitely throw the smoke bomb.
Of course, used scrolls will always have to be collected again.

No more frustration of losing when you own more than 70 scrolls for the first time.
At the same time, it will be necessary to avoid getting hit too much, otherwise you will lose too much time collecting the scrolls.
In higher levels the cost of the smoke bomb increases.
For example at the last, it is 10 scrolls.
Nor will the game become too easy.

So if you had given up on the game, now is the time to get back into it.
If you haven't already, take the opportunity to do the new tutorial for the previous update.

I hope you will enjoy this update.

Good game, and be real BUSHI!

[i]Olivier Raveneau
Mars Touch Studio[/i]

notes.title: New Tutorial!!!
notes.content:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

Throughout this month of June, there have been renovations at my house, dividing by 6 my time spent on projects.

I still managed to do this redesign of the tutorial.
This was becoming urgent, as I found that in addition to boring players, the tutorial was not fulfilling its purpose.
At the end of the previous tutorial, players still didn't know how to play well.

Now more text is displayed on the screen at once and you will have plenty of time to read it at your own pace :)
Everything concerning the sequence of actions and the notions of rhythm and anticipation have been moved to the end of the tutorial.
Just before practice against the Ninjas.

With this new version, it will be more pleasant to redo the tutorial because you will be able to quickly advance the parts that you already master.
Precisely, I invite you to try this new version of the tutorial, you could acquire a new and better understanding of the game.

The difficulty of Ninja Scroller depends on your ability to adapt to the gameplay and your understanding of the game.
Think of Ninja Scroller as an end-of-level boss.
Until you understand its patterns and how to react in each of them, you will die quickly.
But, once everything is clear, you can defeat him effortlessly.
The only limit then is your ability to repeat the effort over time.

The next update will probably concern menu navigation.
No date, because my priority remains Underwater Diving, especially with the delay for the reasons mentioned at the beginning of the post:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

Good game, and be real BUSHI!

Olivier Raveneau
Mars Touch Studio

notes.title: New ability for your Ninja!!!
notes.content:
It's an ability I gave up on during development. I thought this ability would make the game too easy, making dodging unnecessary. And since I'm an idiot, I hadn't tested it.
It's done. This ability will make you better without making the game easy. It will allow you to get out of a difficult situation and vary your game, it opens up new perspectives.

Drum roll !
Now during the [b]acrobatic phase[/b] of the [b]jump[/b], you are [b]invulnerable[/b]!
[b]Jumping[/b] is now [b]also[/b] a [b]dodge[/b]!

Watch out before you ignite.
The accorbatic phase of jumping is short, so if you can now jump through a tornado, you might as well land in it and die if you jump too soon.
But it's fun to dodge a jump kick by jumping yourself :)

Well expected this new ability is not explained in the tutorial that I will try to redesign and shorten for the summer sales.

Because my current priority is to have a Steam demo ready at the beginning of June for Underwater Diving, so that it can participate in the Steam Next Fest at the end of June.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

I still made a small correction in the tutorial.
When I say the attack is dangerous only 2 frames, in fact it's 3 ;)

Conclusion, if you still haven't managed to complete the first level.
Well, now is the time to try again!

Good game, and be real BUSHI!

notes.title: NINJA SCROLLER available on MARCH 31 at 18:00 UTC+2
notes.content:
Good Morning! Good Afternoon! Good Evening! Good Night!

First of all thank you to all those who have chosen to follow the news of the game.

I am [b]Olivier Raveneau[/b] a solo game developer creating games using the [b]Mars Touch Studio[/b] trademark. If as a player I've been on Steam for more than 19 years, it's only been 6 months as a developer. I still need a little time to master the platform and its communication tools. Ninja Scroller is my first commercial game and my first on Steam.

I am pleased to announce that the game will be released on [b]March 31 at 18:00 UTC+2[/b]. If you haven't already, I invite you to warm up with the demo. If a demo is used to make people want to play a game, it also allows players to be filtered. This demo will test your [b]obstinacy[/b] and [b]stamina[/b].

You should know that the game was designed and created to be played on the keyboard with the arrow keys. This is how I play and record all my gameplay videos. During development, I added WASD just in case. Then the controller, because some people just can't play the keyboard.

The game natively supports Xbox controllers. For the others, I will configure Steam Input as best I can. So, if you've had any issues with your favorite controller, that probably won't be the case when the game comes out.

[b]Steam Achievements[/b] are built into the game (not the demo). For more fun with your friends, I added [b]a leaderboard by level[/b], which will be available via the [b]community HUB[/b]. My game is not a competitive game, the levels are randomly generated, so having a great time is as much a matter of skill as it is luck. But it's still fun to show off your excellent time and challenge your friends to do better (even if it doesn't make much sense in all rigor).

At the time of writing this article my game is on [b]532 Whislist[/b]. So after the release, if you like the game, [b]leave a comment[/b], it will be [b]very valuable[/b].

Coming to the end of the road for this game, I will be able to focus again on the following one:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178190/Underwater_Diving/

[b]I wish you good game.[/b]

[i]Olivier Raveneau[/i]
